dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Letter
dialogues.text: "...This Clitopho fellow is not to be trusted! He left the group that went up to steal food to rot, and he let all the Weasel Thieves go free..."

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Letter
dialogues.text: "...We've locked him up, awaiting Erge's judgment..."

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder Letter
dialogues.text: "...By the way, there was an earthquake previously, and some people came down here afterward. Everyone should be on high alert..."
